findings: Duplicate confirmation captures a PendingGroup value including keeper and member URLs, and displays full keeper path plus intentional-nested-copy caution. This is stronger plan presentation than the aggregate organization proposal, but does not fix stale content/identity validation.

Archive/installer confirmation derives selected objects at click time, not dialog opening; selection is intersected with result IDs on updates. Content identity remains unchecked by those UI bindings.
Empty installer results assert every installer is uninstalled or newer despite scanner exclusions, unreadable metadata and omitted components. Empty array cannot justify that exhaustive statement.
Archive UI uses phrase byte-for-byte in size and files verified; original scanner actually compares sizes only, with confirmed equal-size content false positive.

Organization plan buttons have no disabled(isWorking), although handler refuses work when busy and interactive dismissal is disabled. Not Now can clear proposal and replace status while another task is running.
Inspector category correction and Teach controls remain enabled during work. Picker callback calls correctSelected using selection at asynchronous execution time rather than frozen displayed file ID.
Cleanup-center lists do not apply global query filtering in these ranges, so Search Downloads has no corresponding cleanup-result scope. No UI or cleanup was executed.
